2. Heard Sri Santosh Kumar Singh, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Ashfaq Ahmed Ansari,
learned counsel for the first informant, Sri V.D. Ojha, learned AGA for the State and perused the material on record.

3. This bail application under Section439 of Code of Criminal Procedure has been filed by the applicant Musharraf, seeking enlargement on bail during trial in connection with Case Crime No.
229 of 2022, under Section(s) 498A, 323, 307, 376 I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act, registered at P.S. Purkaji,
District Muzaffar Nagar.

Musharraf vs State Of U.P. on 28 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/74441178/
1 4.

The F.I.R. of the matter was lodged on 14.09.2022 by Smt. Sajida against the applicant and 08 other accused persons alleging therein that her elder sister was married to Waseem around 4-1/2 years back, but the accused persons used to demand Rs.5 lakh and a car as dowry and due to non-fulfillment of the same they used to assault and torture her.
After marriage she did not bear a child and thus they used to taunt her as being infertile and used to press her for their demand stating that the same has to be fulfilled anyhow.
Musharraf present applicant and Salamat devar raped her many times which came to be known to them but they did not take any action.

On 11.09.2022 an information was received that her sister has been burnt by the accused persons and was taken to the hospital after which they reached the hospital wherein she told them of the entire incident.
She was then referred to a higher centre.
Her husband after taking advise from a lawyer came there and now he is with her.
5. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the present case.
It is submitted that the victim was found to have received burn injuries and was under treatment and has recovered.

It is submitted that although there is allegation of the applicant and the co-accused Salman committing rape upon the victim but there is no date and time of the alleged incident of rape given in the prosecution case.

It is further submitted that charge sheet in the matter has been submitted on 04.1.2023 against Waseem, Salamat and Munsajaf, under Sections 498A,
307 I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act and against Tahrun Nisha, Musharraf (jeth), Dilruba (jethani) and Nasreen (nanad) under Section 498A I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act, after which a protest petition was filed, subsequent to which the court concerned vide order dated 25.7.2023 took cognizance under Sections 498A, 323, 307, 376 I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act against Musharraf the applicant and Salamat and under Sections 498A, 323, 307 I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act against Waseem, Musajaf, Smt. Tahrun Nisha, Nasreen, Dilruba, Smt. Gulshana and Shahjahan.
It is submitted that the Investigating Officer had found the allegation of rape to be false and thus did not proceed to file charge sheet against the applicant under Section 376 I.P.C.

It is submitted that co-accused Salamat was granted bail under Sections 498A, 307 I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act vide order dated 07.2.2023 passed by the Sessions Judge, Muzaffar Nagar, after which Section 376 I.P.C. was added against him and then he made a prayer for bail before this Court through Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.18801 of 2024,
Shalamat vs. State of U.P., in which a co-ordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 5.7.2024 granted bail to him in the said section, the said orders have been placed before the Court which are annexed as annexure no.8 to the affidavit.

sentences.text: It is submitted that implication of the applicant is only because of the reason that he is jeth of the victim.

It is submitted that the applicant is involved in one other case in which he is on bail, para-3 of the supplementary affidavit dated 7.3.2025 and annexure no. S.A.-1 to the same have been placed being the order granting bail, has been placed before the Court.
It is argued that the applicant is in jail since 11.10.2024.
6. Per contra, learned State counsel opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that the applicant is named in the F.I.R. and there are allegation against him.
7. After having heard learned counsels for the parties and perusing the record, it is evident that the applicant is jeth of the victim.

Initially charge sheet was submitted against Waseem, Salamat and Munsajaf (the present applicant), under Sections 498A, 307 I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act and against Tahrun Nisha, Musharraf (jeth), Dilruba (jethani) and Nasreen (nanad) under Section 498A I.P.C.
Musharraf vs State Of U.P. on 28 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/74441178/
2 and 3/4 D.P. Act, after which a protest petition was filed on which the trial court concerned took cognizance under Sections 498A, 323, 307, 376 I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act against the applicant and the co-accused Salamat and under Sections 498A, 323, 307 I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act against Waseem,
Musajaf, Smt. Tahrun Nisha, Nasreen, Dilruba, Smt. Gulshana and Shahjahan.
Co-accused Salamat has been granted bail.
Date and time of the alleged incident of rape is not mentioned in the prosecution case.

8. Looking to the facts and circumstances of this case, the nature of evidence and also the absence of any convincing material to indicate the possibility of tampering with the evidence, this Court is of the view that the applicant may be enlarged on bail.

9. Let the applicant- Musharraf, be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions which are being imposed in the interest of justice:-
i) The applicant will not tamper with prosecution evidence and will not harm or harass the victim/complainant in any manner whatsoever.
ii) The applicant will abide the orders of court, will attend the court on every date and will not delay the disposal of trial in any manner whatsoever.
(iii) The applicant shall file an undertaking to the effect that he shall not seek any adjournment on the date fixed for evidence when the witnesses are present in court.
In case of default of this condition, it shall be open for the trial court to treat it as abuse of liberty of bail and pass orders in accordance with law.
(iv) The applicant will not misuse the liberty of bail in any manner whatsoever.

In case, the applicant misuses the liberty of bail during trial and in order to secure his presence proclamation under section 82 Cr.P.C., may be issued and if applicant fails to appear before the court on the date fixed in such proclamation, then, the trial court shall initiate proceedings against him, in accordance with law, under section 174-A I.P.C.
(V) The applicant shall remain present, in person, before the trial court on dates fixed for (1) opening of the case, (2) framing of charge and (3) recording of statement under Section 313 Cr.P.C.

If in the opinion of the trial court absence of the applicant is deliberate or without sufficient cause, then it shall be open for the trial court to treat such default as abuse of liberty of bail and proceed against him in accordance with law and the trial court may proceed against him under Section 229-A IPC.
(vi) The trial court may make all possible efforts/endeavour and try to conclude the trial expeditiously after the release of the applicant.

Musharraf vs State Of U.P. on 28 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/74441178/
3 10.

The identity, status and residential proof of sureties will be verified by court concerned and in case of breach of any of the conditions mentioned above, court concerned will be at liberty to cancel the bail and send the applicant to prison.
11. The bail application is allowed.
12. Pending application(s), if any, shall stand disposed of.
(Samit Gopal,J.) Order Date :- 28.5.2025
